verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰੀ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ਕਉਸਿ ਦੀ ਮਕੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: dharee neesaanee kaus dhee make a(n)dhar pooj karaiee|

en.bdb: Wooden sandal (of Baba Nanak ) was kept as a memory and he was woshipped in Mecca.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਜਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਾਬੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਖਾਲੀ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: jithai jai jagat vich baabe baajh na khaalee jaiee|

en.bdb: Go anywhere in the world, you would not find a place bereft of the name of Baba Nanak.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਗੁਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: ghar ghar baabaa poojeeaai hi(n)dhoo musalamaan guaaiee|

en.bdb: Without discrimination of Hindu or Muslim, in every house, the Baba is revered.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਪੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਛਪਾਇਆ ਚੜਿਆ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਜਗੁ ਰੁਸਨਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: chhape naeh chhapaiaa chaRiaa sooraj jag rusanaiee|

en.bdb: When the sun rises it cannot be covered and it lightens the whole world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੁਕਿਆ ਸਿੰਘ ਉਜਾੜ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਰਗਾਵਲਿ ਭੰਨੀ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bukiaa si(n)gh ujaaR vich sabh miragaaval bha(n)nee jaiee|

en.bdb: When the lion roared in the jungle the flocks of deer ran away.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੜਿਆ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਲੁਕਈ ਕਢਿ ਕੁਨਾਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਛਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: chaRiaa cha(n)dh na lukiee kadd kunaalee jot chhapaiee|

en.bdb: If someone wants to conceal moon by putting before it a platter, it cannot be hide.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਗਵਣਹੁ ਤੇ ਆਥਵਣੋ ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਸਭਾ ਝੁਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: augavanahu te aathavano nau kha(n)dd pirathamee sabhaa jhukaiee|

en.bdb: From rising to setting  directions i.e from east to west, all the nine divisions of earth bowed before Baba Nanak.
He diffused his power in whole of the world.
